title: rustle configuration reference
description: Reference of every key of rustle's config.toml: type, default, description and whether `rustle reload` applies it. Generated from the config structs by `cargo test -p rustle config_reference`; read by the rustle website at the release tag.

$schema.title: Schema pointer
$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editors.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this contract. A breaking change bumps it; readers must refuse a version they do not know.

version.title: rustle version
version.description: The rustle version this reference describes.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The [tables] of config.toml, in reading order.

scalar.title: Scalar
scalar.description: A TOML scalar written as JSON.

name.title: Name
name.description: Table name, as written between brackets in config.toml.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: The keys of the table, in reading order.

type.title: Type
type.description: TOML type. duration is a string such as "5s" or "1m"; enum is a string among values.

values.title: Values
values.description: The accepted strings, for an enum.

default.title: Default
default.description: Default value (durations as strings such as "1m"; lists as arrays).

description.title: Description
description.description: What the key does; plain text with `code` spans.

reload.title: Reload
reload.description: live: `rustle reload` applies it to new connections. restart: only a restart applies it (a reload keeps the running value and reports it).
